title: Rooms where power meets
subtitle: Elite forums and agenda frameworks are real; a hydra command centre is UNSUPPORTED; influence is not harmless brunch

overall.label: Forums and soft-law agendas are KNOWN; hydra world-government via Davos/Bilderberg is UNSUPPORTED; influence paths are PROBABLE
overall.confidence: Very high on existence and non-binding character; high against hydra-as-established; high on influence as mechanism not meeting→law
overall.summary: People with shared interests meet, fund, hire, and lobby. That is a social fact. Secret world government is a separate extraordinary claim. The World Economic Forum exists: Klaus Schwab founded the European Management Forum in 1971; Davos is the public brand ritual. Bilderberg Meetings have run since 1954; official About text: no detailed agenda, no resolutions proposed, no votes taken, no policy statements issued; ~130 invitees; Chatham House Rule; participants as individuals. UN 2030 Agenda / SDGs are a goal framework, not automatically enforceable world statute; follow-up includes voluntary national reviews. Australia delivered its first VNR at the UN HLPF on 17 July 2018 — national mediation, not forum decree. Influence paths (networks, NGOs, consultancies, philanthropy, revolving doors, standard-setting, statutory markets such as the EU ETS) are PROBABLE as mechanism; ‘this meeting caused that law’ remains case-by-case. Twin process failures: conspiracy culture upgrades rooms into a hydra; respectable coverage downgrades them into harmless TED. Climate physics is out. Protocols-adjacent ethnic cabals are out. Twin file: algorithmic attention (EF022).

claims.claim: Coordination is not conspiracy. Shared meetings, funding, hiring, and lobbying are ordinary elite behaviour. A secret command centre that runs major policy domains via these forums is a separate claim with an extraordinary bar. Attendance is not guilt. Branding is not statute.
claims.why: Architectural. Twin to money-systems ‘institution without hydra’ and to EF022 A0.

claims.claim: WEF-class and Bilderberg-class forums are real. Bilderberg: inaugural 1954 (Hotel De Bilderberg, Oosterbeek); about 130 invitees a year; about two-thirds Europe, one-third North America; about one-third politics/government; Chatham House Rule; participants as individuals not in official capacity. Official sentence: ‘There is no detailed agenda, no resolutions are proposed, no votes are taken, and no policy statements are issued.’ WEF: Schwab founded the European Management Forum in 1971 (first European Management Symposium, Davos, January 1971); Swiss-based organisation for public–private cooperation; renamed World Economic Forum in 1987. Existence is not in serious dispute.
claims.why: Two independent organisational primaries. Official no-resolutions sentence constrains hydra completion; it does not erase networking power.

claims.claim: Agenda 2030 / the SDGs are a political goal framework, not automatically binding world law. UN framing: not legally binding; countries take national ownership; follow-up includes voluntary national reviews. Australia’s first Voluntary National Review was delivered at the UN HLPF on 17 July 2018 — a ‘whole of Australia’ report (government, business, civil society), coordinated domestically (PM&C / DFAT class). Soft goals can still drive funding, reporting, consultancy markets, and statute drafting via domestic politics. That is influence, not automatic override of sovereignty.
claims.why: UN primary plus independent AU domestic path. Blocks both ‘world statute’ and ‘empty theatre therefore powerless.’

claims.confidence: High as mechanism; residual on meeting→law chains
claims.claim: Documented influence paths into policy include elite networking, think-tanks, NGOs, consultancies, philanthropy, revolving doors, standard-setting, and market design. EU ETS is a legal cap-and-trade instrument (2005–), not a Davos handshake; design critiques (over-allocation, free allowances, windfall, integrity) are policy-design / rent residuals, not hydra proof. Case-by-case ‘this meeting caused that law’ is not established as a general rule.
claims.why: Path types plus one statutory market. Near-KNOWN mechanism; not a complete causal map.

claims.claim: Twin process failures. Conspiracy upgrade: invite list + privacy → ‘they decide everything at Davos.’ Discriminator: Bilderberg’s no-resolutions/votes/statements; Agenda non-binding; WEF is not a legislature. Respectable downgrade: ‘just TED / networking brunch.’ Discriminator: invite concentration, Chatham House opacity, partner funding, agenda-setting residual. Opacity is not proof of crime and not proof of innocence of influence.
claims.why: Symmetry without mush. Both failures are process.

claims.claim: Each strong capture claim needs its own ledger line. Climate physics is not on trial in this file; policy instruments and markets are. Protocols / ethnic-money myths stay out: agents are institutions and classes, not ethnic cabals. Algorithmic attention is a twin spine (EF022), not evidence that forums run the feed.

A single secret ownership or control conspiracy that runs major policy domains via WEF/Bilderberg-class forums as a command centre is UNSUPPORTED as established. Explaining C2–C5 does not require that hydra. Extraordinary control claims still need control documents, not invite lists. Self-description is not automatically a cover story, and official ‘no votes’ is not automatically proof of impotence.
claims.why: Load-bearing negative. Same discipline as money-systems cabal line.

methodAudit.name: Grammar
methodAudit.note: Rooms, soft law, influence paths, hydra, and climate physics are separate. ‘They’ as one noun smuggles C7 into C2.

methodAudit.name: Logic
methodAudit.note: H-hydra rejected as established. H-brunch rejected. H-world-law rejected. Hidden premises blocked: privacy = crime; no votes = impotence; SDGs = statute; attendance = guilt.

methodAudit.name: Rhetoric
methodAudit.note: Stripped: Davos world government; just TED; Protocols adjacency. Neutral: invite rules; non-binding; VNR; ETS statute.

methodAudit.name: Reality
methodAudit.note: Discriminators: Bilderberg no-resolutions sentence; AU VNR 2018; EU ETS as law. Controls: opacity residual; design rents.

methodAudit.name: Independence
methodAudit.note: Bilderberg ≠ WEF ≠ UN ≠ DFAT ≠ EU ETS.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 1 — Laundering Davos
methodAudit.note: Attack: you protect elites. Response: C5 downgrade residual explicit; C4 influence PROBABLE; C7 still UNSUPPORTED.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 2 — Cover story
methodAudit.note: Attack: ‘no votes’ is camouflage. Response: official text constrains resolution claims; extraordinary control still needs control docs.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 3 — VNR is theatre
methodAudit.note: Attack: paperwork proves nothing. Response: theatre is still national mediation — proves domestic path, not impotence of soft goals.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 4 — Protocols adjacency
methodAudit.note: Attack: forums are the ethnic cabal. Response: explicit non-goal; institutions and classes, not ethnic myths.
